Add sample-twin: a continuous-time twin certifies PD at every gain, the real zero-order-hold loop is stable iff kp T/2 < kd < 2/T (wn T < min(4 zeta, 1/zeta)), overshoot is 5x the twin's at wn T = 1.2, faster twin-tuned gains settle slower, deadbeat (2 samples) is the real speed limit (companion to timestep-twin and latency-twin)

Add jitter-twin: a twin fitted to the sensor-delay histogram is blind to its persistence; i.i.d. jitter barely moves the mean-square gain limit, lag-1 autocorrelation 0.9 cuts it 1.00 -> 0.67, and almost-sure stability hides it (companion to latency-twin)

Add impact-twin: fixed-step twin of a bouncing ball; true Zeno rest time is hypersensitive to restitution (2/(1-e^2)), twin restitution and settling time are O(dt) off with scheme-dependent sign, first-bounce calibration is not a reliable fix (companion to timestep-twin and friction-twin)

Add drag-twin: linear-drag twin of a quadratic-drag vehicle; coast-down time and terminal speed off by fit-speed ratios, LSQ fit k=3c*vmax/4, safe speed under a stopping limit mis-stated -21% to +41% with sign set by the fit speed (companion to timestep-twin and impact-twin)

Add thermal-twin: a constant-gain twin of a motor holding a load certifies every load; magnet derating gives a fold at lambda=4/27, no hold above it, finite runaway time, short tests cannot see it, refitting a constant gain does not remove it (companion to windup-twin and gravity-twin)

Add slip-twin: kinematic-bicycle twin ignores tyre slip; steady-turn radius is off by exactly 1+Kv^2/L, calibrating K fixes it but both twins certify steering gains stable at every speed while 11 of 30 real gain pairs lose stability below 60 m/s (companion to sample-twin and latency-twin)

Add roundtrip-twin: zero-wind twin of a UAV out-and-back leg; wind does not cancel (real/twin energy 1/(1-(w/v)^2)), twin-optimal airspeed too slow, one-leg-calibrated twin off by exactly +-w/v with the sign of the leg flown (companion to uav-energy-twin and drag-twin)

Add grid-twin: k-connected grid twin over-states route length by a heading-dependent factor independent of cell size (8-connected mean 8(sqrt2-1)/pi, max 1.0824), calibrating the mean leaves -5.2%..+2.6%, route rankings flip with map orientation (companion to occupancy-twin and terrain-twin)

Add gust-twin: variance-matched iid-gust twin understates a PD-held vehicle's position variance by 2(a+kd)/(dt(a^2+a kd+kp)) (141x at a=1, dt=0.01; std scales as sqrt(dt)), spectrum-matched white twin is always conservative (companion to safety-twin and autocorr-twin)

Add shutter-twin: global-shutter twin of a rolling-shutter camera ignores target motion; moving rectangle is sheared/stretched by exact closed forms, twin-trained orientation estimate is biased by half the edge tilt, one frame of a known-size target identifies pose and velocity (companion to doppler-twin and latency-twin)

Add lens-twin: pinhole twin of a radially distorted camera mis-ranges floor points by exactly 1/(1+k1 h^2/R^2), a twin-trained braking policy stops 9 cm short of 1 m, focal calibration trades near-field for far-field error, one grid image identifies k1 (companion to shutter-twin and occupancy-twin)

Add inertia-twin: point-mass twin of a rolling body overstates ramp acceleration by exactly 1+k, slip threshold k tan(a)/(1+k) invisible to the twin, twin-trained coast launch overshoots 40-100%, one calibration cannot fix a mixed fleet (companion to friction-twin, slip-twin and drag-twin)

Add gyro-twin: white-noise gyro twin hides the bias random walk; heading variance ratio exactly 1+(t/t*)^2, re-alignment interval 24x too long, single-point Allan fit right at one horizon only, dead-reckoning range over-stated 1.25-1.74x (companion to odometry-twin and rendezvous-twin)

Add blur-twin: instantaneous-exposure twin of a finite-exposure camera certifies detection at every speed; moving bar is an exact trapezoid, twin-tuned peak detector has speed limit wC/(sigma z), blur-matched box filter raises it quadratically (companion to shutter-twin and doppler-twin)
